tools.name: search_commercial_ads
tools.description: Search active commercial video, image, carousel, and search ads by keyword, niche, or brand across Meta Ad Library (Facebook/Instagram) and Google Ads Transparency. Returns hook copy, headlines, CTAs, HD video/image URLs, destination landing pages, active days running, and winner signals. Cost: 2 Cr

tools.name: search_meta_ad_library
tools.description: Query active commercial Meta (Facebook/Instagram/Messenger) ads by keyword or brand. Returns full hook copy, HD video MP4 URLs, creative thumbnails, CTA buttons, destination landing page URLs with UTMs, collation variation counts, and active days running. Cost: 2 Credits / ad returned.

tools.name: search_google_ads_transparency
tools.description: Search verified Google Ads Transparency creatives (YouTube video, Display image, Search text ads) by advertiser domain or keyword. Returns verified advertiser ID, creative format, first_shown / last_shown dates, days running, preview image URLs, and official transparency links. Cost: 2 Credits / ad

tools.name: get_advertiser_ads_dossier
tools.description: Fetch a unified competitor advertiser dossier across Meta Ad Library and Google Ads Transparency by domain (e.g. "monday.com") or brand name. Returns verified advertiser status, approx Google active ads count, format breakdown, top CTAs, top destination landing pages, longest running creative days,

tools.name: audit_ad_landing_page
tools.description: Inspect any commercial ad landing page URL in real time: extracts above-the-fold H1 headline, offer structure (pricing mentions, free trial, demo CTA, discounts, no-credit-card claims), primary CTAs, redirect hops, and 12 tracking pixels (meta_pixel, gtag, gtm, tiktok_pixel, linkedin_insight, hubspo
